faqs.q: How long does water purification system installation take?
faqs.a: Most residential installations can be completed in 2-4 hours, depending on the system type and complexity.

faqs.q: Do you offer warranties on water purification systems?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide manufacturer warranties ranging from 5-10 years and a 1-year warranty on our installation work.

faqs.q: How often should I maintain my water purification system?
faqs.a: Filter replacements are typically needed every 6-12 months, depending on usage and water quality. We offer annual maintenance plans for optimal performance.

faqs.q: Are your technicians certified for water purification installation?
faqs.a: Yes, all our technicians are certified and licensed in New York State, with specific training in water purification system installation and maintenance.
